title: A field has modes
provenance: REAL_PUBLIC. Open-Meteo ERA5-Land daily 2 m temperatures on the 0.2° Pearl River Delta lattice (script 50 cache). Exposure descriptives only. No health outcomes. No project coefficients.

methods.name: EOF / PCA of seasonally anomalized daily Tmin
methods.note: Area-weighted SVD after subtracting each cell’s day-of-year climatology. Not a health factor.

methods.name: Annual harmonic amplitude and phase
methods.note: One annual Fourier pair per cell. Phase is the day of year of the fitted Tmin maximum.

methods.name: Theil–Sen trend of yearly mean Tmin, with Mann–Kendall S
methods.note: Eleven years only. A slope is a description of this window, not a detection of climate change for the paper.

methods.name: k-means on standardised climatology (k=4)
methods.note: Features: mean Tmin, hot-night count, harmonic amplitude, distance to coast, elevation. Labels are interpretive.

methods.name: Spatial entropy of hot-night occupancy; MI with the Headquarters cell
methods.note: Evenness near 1 would mean 28°C nights are spread across the delta. They are not.

methods.name: Hot-night spell persistence and P(HN | VHD)
methods.note: Runs of Tmin ≥ 28°C. Joint occurrence with Tmax ≥ 33°C on the same calendar day.

methods.name: Wasserstein-1 distance of daily Tmin from the Headquarters cell
methods.note: A distributional distance, not kilometres and not a hospital catchment.

methods.name: Anomaly-correlation graph, edge if r > 0.9
methods.note: Cells whose de-seasoned nights move together. Not a patient-sharing network.

eof.note: EOF1 is flipped so marine-south mean loading is non-negative. A mode is a pattern on this grid, not a finding about hospitalisation.

trend.note: Eleven annual means. A slope whose bootstrap interval covers zero is not a detection. Do not paste as a climate-change result.

model.note: A 0.2° cell is not a city, a weather station, or a hospital catchment. Do not transport Hong Kong CHD/HF ratios. Live paper stays on HKO Headquarters.

claim_boundaries: Do not treat EOF loadings as hospitalisation factors.
Do not treat k-means labels as neighbourhoods or catchments.
Do not paste Theil–Sen slopes as a climate-change finding in the live paper.
Do not overlay CHD/HF or stroke counts on cells.
Do not transport Hong Kong hospitalisation ratios to Shenzhen or Guangzhou.
Live paper stays on HKO official flags.
